remarks: Experience a rare opportunity to own a turnkey, multi-use hospitality property in the heart of Houghton, NY. Set on 87+ scenic acres, this expansive campground offers 90+ sites with room to grow! Featuring deluxe cabins, RV pull-through and back-in sites, tent areas, bath houses, entertainment spaces, hiking trails, and a lake! All RV sites and cabins have electric service, plus a FULL-COVERAGE Wi-Fi and camera system is included. The main lodge offers heated indoor AND outdoor pools, games, and crafts, while the storefront handles check-ins, rentals, supplies, and souvenirs. An on-site apartment provides convenient owner or manager housing. The property also showcases a custom-upgraded (2022) 3-bedroom home for rental or owner-occupancy flexibility, complemented by a 2020 built horse barn and arena with 8 stables for added equestrian appeal!! Located just 13 miles from Letchworth State Park, this property is PERFECT for investors, developers, or entrepreneurs seeking a thriving campground, retreat center, or outdoor resort with outstanding expansion potential!
